correctness.rationale: A positive compact Jacobi matrix has isolated simple Perron top eigenvalue lambda. Tail resolvents imply psi_N=psi_0 lambda^-N prod_{j<N}a_j prod_{j=1}^N lambda G_j; zero diagonal gives lambda G_j=1+O(q^(2j)), convergent positive C. Compare finite endpoint phi_N to psi_N using finite tail Green factors, a uniform summable O(q^(2j)) tail and N(lambda-lambda_N)->0, establishing crucial relative (not merely norm) convergence. Schur complement and bounded nonprincipal spectral remainder give exact eigenvalue defect a_N^2 G_{N+1} phi_N^2/(1-a_N^2 G_{N+1}R_N); hence first order and q^(N(N+1)) scaling for fixed parameters. Independent double-precision short-cutoff checks q=.78,.83,.67 at N=7,9,6 match leading ratio within .3%; larger cutoff suffered roundoff and was explicitly excluded, NOT evidence against theorem.
